About me

I’m a barista with a passion for good coffee and great service. I enjoy creating quality drinks, working with people, and making sure every customer has a good experience.

Outside of work, I’m also building my skills in tech and working towards my goal of becoming a software developer.

What I bring

At the bar

  • Espresso and milk drinks. Pulling shots and steaming milk for lattes, cappuccinos, and more.
  • Latte art. Pouring clean leaf patterns, like the one in the photo above.
  • Customer service. Taking orders, listening to preferences, and keeping the line moving.

On the computer

  • HTML and CSS. Building responsive pages, including this portfolio.
  • JavaScript basics. Adding small interactions, like the mobile menu on this page.
  • Problem solving. Breaking a bug into small steps, the same way I fix a bad espresso shot.
